dialogues.speaker: Behrouz
dialogues.text: You probably know that we cross-border merchants fear mishaps at sea the most.

dialogues.speaker: Behrouz
dialogues.text: I'm a seasoned ship owner, and very experienced in dealing with the issues, but these sea monsters still give me headaches.

dialogues.speaker: Behrouz
dialogues.text: And there are those vicious Kairagi too. It's no joke when they sink fortunes.

dialogues.speaker: Behrouz
dialogues.text: It's best to avoid things like these if possible. I'll need to plan my next sailing route now...
